title: Saying 'Not now' or 'I skip this on purpose' to one muscle suggestion does not quiet the other one
what: Two features talk about the same weak muscle: the Balance check card on Charts and the 'Smart suggestion' muscle tip on the Up next card. Each keeps its own 'Not now' memory in a different place, and the tip's 'I skip this on purpose' (stop asking) is never read by the Charts card. A member who tells the tip to stop asking about calves still sees the Charts card say calves are trained much less, and a member who says 'Not now' on Charts can get a tip to add a calf exercise on the next workout. After the member taps Add on the tip, the Charts card keeps the warning for weeks, because it reads only past workouts.
expected: One answer per muscle: 'Not now' or 'skip on purpose' in either place quiets both for the same time, and the Charts card says the muscle was added to the plan once the member took the tip.
who: members with Muscle tips on (the default)
how_often: every time the two features pick the same muscle
fix_line: Keep one quiet list per muscle that both the Charts card and the Up next tip read and write

title: Tapping 'Your gym saved your body measurements' or a new diet plan pop-up can show the old copy for up to 10 minutes
what: The phone asks the gym for trainer measurements and diet plans at most every 10 minutes. The pop-up says 'Tap to see them', but the tap opens the page the normal way, so if the member opened the Body page or Gym tab in the last 10 minutes (common while standing with the trainer) the new measurement or diet plan is not there yet. The workout plan pop-up has the same fault, already written down.
expected: Opening the page from a measurement or diet pop-up asks the gym again at once, so what the pop-up names is there.
who: members of gyms whose trainers save measurements or diet plans
how_often: when the pop-up comes within 10 minutes of opening the Body page or Gym tab
fix_line: Make the measurement and diet pop-up taps ask the gym again straight away

title: The one-time repairs at app start change workout times and routines with no word to the member, and a failure leaves no trace
what: At start-up (and after a restore) the app moves old imported workout times and rewrites routines copied from a Hevy link (warm-up counts and routine order). It counts how many it changed but nobody is told: the member just finds a routine in a new order or a workout at a different hour. When a repair fails at start-up it is swallowed with no log line, so a repair that keeps failing every launch cannot be seen or diagnosed.
expected: A short one-time note ('We fixed the times of 12 imported workouts and the warm-ups in 3 routines copied from Hevy'), and a log line each time a repair fails.
who: members who imported from Hevy or Strong before the fix
how_often: once per phone (and again after restoring an older backup)
fix_line: Show the repair counts once and log every repair failure
